def node.Advance.unifiedSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (st : NodeDriverState) (es : List EntryM) (L : Option SnapLoan)
    (v : ConfigView),
    st.handling = some (es, L) →
      NoConfChangeIn st.delivered v.applied st.delivered.length →
        (∀ (l : SnapLoan),
            L = some l →
              l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave' = false ∧ l.dlv.length = uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index') →
          ⊢
            ∀ Φ,
              (isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                  isCluster γ N ∗
                    nodeDriver n γ N st ∗
                      advReceipt st.storage es L ∗
                        nodeConfig n γ N v ∗
                          match L with
                          | none => True
                          | some l => snapshotCert γ N (snapTrip l.snap l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists)) -∗
                ▷
                    ((nodeDriver n γ N
                          { storage := st.storage, delivered := st.delivered, hardState := st.hardState,
                            handling := none } ∗
                        match L with
                        | none =>
                          nodeConfig n γ N v ∗
                            ∃ x,
                              storFloor st.storage x ∗
                                ⌜↑st.delivered.length ≤ uint.Z x⌝ ∗
                                  storTermsAt st.storage (List.map LogEntry.term st.delivered)
                        | some l =>
                          ∃ m,
                            nodeConfig n γ N { applied := uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index', membership := m } ∗
                              confAt γ (uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index') m ∗
                                ⌜confStateIs l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState' m⌝) -∗
                      Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                  WP
                    ((intoVal (methods node.ty.PointerType go!"Advance" (intoVal n)))
                      (intoVal ()))
                    {{ Φ }}
